exact_semantic_question: What does a geometric-mean reporting comment require for comparison of individual monitoring-period values?
relation_contract: aggregated reporting is not an ordinary single-period numeric comparison

candidate_interpretations.description: Individual monitoring-period DMR values must not be compared directly to the limit; compliance requires computing a geometric mean over weekly sub-period samples and comparing that aggregate (or reporting it where limits say 'Report').

The comment governs only how values are reported on the DMR (geometric mean of weekly values) while numeric limits may still use a different statistic (e.g., 30-day average) for enforcement comparison.
The geometric-mean comment is TDS-specific permit language propagated at limit-set level to unrelated parameters; it does not change comparison semantics for non-TDS limits.
Structured sources do not establish how monthly DMR values relate to weekly geometric means or which aggregation window applies for limit comparison.

contradictory_evidence: All 40 structured rows with the geometric-mean comment use STATISTICAL_BASE_TYPE_CODE in {AVG, MAX, MIN} — none encode geometric mean as the structured comparison basis.
DMR measurements store one value per MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE (monthly), not weekly sub-period samples, yet limits show LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE 05/WK for many affected parameters.

Statement of basis describes TDS enforcement limit as 30-day average while footnote *6 requires geometric mean of weekly values for discharge reporting — two different statistics without workspace text linking them for comparison.
BOD and other non-TDS parameters carry a comment that explicitly names only TDS, undermining a uniform interpretation across all 40 occurrences.
known_limitations: No codebook or structured legend maps STATISTICAL_BASE_TYPE_CODE to geometric mean.
Weekly sub-period sample values are not present in dmr_measurements.csv; cannot verify whether reported monthly values are pre-aggregated geometric means.
Only NM0020583 (farmington) permit documents were opened; all 40 occurrences belong to that permit's limit set 3600645646.
Permit documents for aztec and gcc contain unrelated geometric-mean mentions (metals RP analysis, fecal coliform) not tied to this obligation's DMR_COMMENT_TEXT trigger.
